talk.text: ……啊！现在的事要对七深保密哦！

talk.name: v01
talk.text: ……真白居然还有这样一面……

talk.name: v02
talk.text: 啊，对不起，我净说些消极的话

talk.name: v03
talk.text: 啊、等等！要先热身才行……！

talk.name: v04
talk.text: 啊，还是请鸫学姐先来吧！

talk.name: v05
talk.text: 啊！对不起，突然说起这种事

talk.name: v06
talk.text: 诶，透子！？你已经来了！？

talk.name: v07
talk.text: 多亏了你，我度过了一个难忘的圣诞节哦

talk.name: v08
talk.text: 香织。这个等客人来了再说

talk.name: v09
talk.text: 这种时候应该说，我们一起加油才对吧？

talk.name: v10
talk.text: 这条半裙果然很可爱啊……

talk.name: v11
talk.text: 好大的哈欠……你昨天睡好了吗？

talk.name: v12
talk.text: 我超级不安的……

talk.name: v13
talk.text: 是、是这样吗……？谢谢您！

talk.name: v14
talk.text: 所以，你绝对不能否定这个想法

talk.name: v15
talk.text: 这、这也……太厉害了吧……

talk.name: v16
talk.text: 是的！我刚和大家分开

talk.name: v17
talk.text: 哼哼，去要一份商品目录吧！

talk.name: v18
talk.text: 呼……好沉啊！

talk.name: v19
talk.text: 真是的~~~！！实在是太丢人了！！

talk.name: v20
talk.text: 哇啊，好期待你会画什么呢！

talk.name: v21
talk.text: 隔着袜子我怎么可能看得出来啊！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v02
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 啊，对不起，我净说些消极的话

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v03
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 啊、等等！要先热身才行……！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v04

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v05
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 啊！对不起，突然说起这种事

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v06
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 诶，透子！？你已经来了！？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v07
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 多亏了你，我度过了一个难忘的圣诞节哦

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v08
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 香织。这个等客人来了再说

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v09
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 这种时候应该说，我们一起加油才对吧？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v10
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 这条半裙果然很可爱啊……

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v11
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 好大的哈欠……你昨天睡好了吗？

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v12
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 我超级不安的……

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v13
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 是、是这样吗……？谢谢您！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v14
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 所以，你绝对不能否定这个想法

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v15
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 这、这也……太厉害了吧……

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v16
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 是的！我刚和大家分开

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v17
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 哼哼，去要一份商品目录吧！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v18
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 呼……好沉啊！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v19
l2d_voice_extra#2.text: 真是的~~~！！实在是太丢人了！！

l2d_voice_extra#2.name: v20
